clock_waveform.ck: differential CK_t/CK_c; commands captured on the rising edge
clock_waveform.dqs: differential DQS_t/DQS_c; data on both edges (double data rate)
clock_waveform.dll: on-die DLL aligns DQS/DQ output to CK

command_frame_waveform.setup_param_tIS: Address / Command / CKE / ODT setup before rising CK (slew-rate-dependent; ~125-200 ps base).
command_frame_waveform.hold_param_tIH: Address / Command / CKE / ODT hold after rising CK (~200 ps base).

read_burst_waveform_BL8.read_latency_RL: RL = AL + CL (e.g., AL=0 + CL=5 → 5 cycles; AL=CL-1=4 + CL=5 → 9 cycles)
read_burst_waveform_BL8.DQS_postamble: tRPST (~ 0.5 tCK) after last data edge
read_burst_waveform_BL8.tCCD_after_RD: 4 nCK before next column command to same rank
read_burst_waveform_BL8.tRTP: Internal Read-to-Precharge ≥ max(4 nCK, 7.5 ns) before PRE to that bank

write_burst_waveform_BL8.DQS_postamble: tWPST (~ 0.5 tCK) after last data edge
write_burst_waveform_BL8.tWR_to_precharge: Last write data → PRE delay ≥ 15 ns / programmed WR cycles
write_burst_waveform_BL8.tWTR_to_read: Last write data → RD ≥ max(4 nCK, 7.5 ns)

initialization_waveform.step_1_VDD_ramp: VDD and VDDQ ramp; RESET# kept LOW (≤ 0.2 × VDD); CKE pulled LOW before RESET# deassertion (≥ 10 ns).
initialization_waveform.step_2_RESET_deassert: RESET# rises HIGH; wait 500 µs; CK becomes stable; CKE remains LOW with NOP/DES.
initialization_waveform.step_3_CKE_rise: CKE rising captured on stable CK (tIS satisfied); wait tXPR before first MRS.
initialization_waveform.step_4_MRS_MR2: MRS to MR2 with application settings (CWL, SRT, Rtt_WR).
initialization_waveform.step_5_MRS_MR3: MRS to MR3 (MPR disabled by default A2=0).
initialization_waveform.step_6_MRS_MR1: MRS to MR1 (DLL enabled A0=0, Rtt_Nom, AL, driver impedance).
initialization_waveform.step_7_MRS_MR0: MRS to MR0 with application settings AND DLL Reset (A8=1).
initialization_waveform.step_8_ZQCL: ZQCL issued to start full impedance calibration.
initialization_waveform.step_9_wait: Wait both tDLLK (512 nCK) and tZQinit (512 nCK) — DRAM ready for normal operation.

self_refresh_entry_exit.entry: From All-Banks-Idle: CKE LOW with SRE; wait tCKESR; CK may stop after tCKSRE.
self_refresh_entry_exit.exit: Restart CK ≥ tCKSRX before CKE rising; wait tXS / tXSDLL; one extra REF before re-entry.

write_leveling_waveform.entry: MRS MR1 A7=1 (WL enable) with all output drivers disabled (MR1 A12=1) OR enabled subset.
write_leveling_waveform.step_3: Controller drives one DQS / DQS# pulse; DRAM samples CK/CK# on the rising DQS edge.
write_leveling_waveform.step_4: DRAM drives the sampled value on DQ (the 'prime' DQ bit, or all DQ); controller reads it back at tWLO.
write_leveling_waveform.step_5: Controller adjusts DQS-to-CK delay; repeats until first 0→1 transition observed.
write_leveling_waveform.step_6: Exit WL: MRS MR1 A7=0 + tMOD.

general_timing_rule: A bank must be ACTIVE (row open, tRCD met) before a column READ/WRITE; PRECHARGE (tRP) closes the row; tRAS is the minimum row-active time; REFRESH occurs within tREFI with tRFC recovery. Bank-group timings (tCCD_S/L, tRRD_S/L, tWTR_S/L) gate back-to-back accesses.
timing_tables_referenced: Table 65 — Timing Parameters by Speed Bin
Section 12 — Electrical Characteristics & AC Timing for DDR3-800 to DDR3-1600
Section 13 — Electrical Characteristics and AC Timing (incl. Setup/Hold/Slew-Rate Derating)

command_waveform.activate: ACT_n=L opens a row (BG, BA, row); tRCD to a column access
command_waveform.read: ACT_n=H, CAS_n=L, WE_n=H; data burst CL later on DQS edges
command_waveform.write: ACT_n=H, CAS_n=L, WE_n=L; data captured CWL later on DQS
command_waveform.precharge: ACT_n=H, RAS_n=L, WE_n=L; tRP before the next ACTIVATE

burst_waveform.otf: A12/BC_n selects BL8 vs BC4 per command
burst_waveform.write_crc: an 8-bit write-CRC frame follows the BL8 write burst when enabled (MR2)

bank_group_waveform.tCCD_S: back-to-back column accesses to different bank groups (short)
bank_group_waveform.tCCD_L: column accesses to the same bank group (long)

data_rate_waveform.relation: data rate (MT/s) = 2 x CK frequency (double data rate)
